quickStart.title: Quick Start Wizard
quickStart.subtitle: Connect a model provider in four steps: pick provider → paste key → import models → grab a key to call.
quickStart.providerHint: Select the model provider you want to connect. We will pre-fill the base URL and protocol for you.
quickStart.customDesc: If your provider is not in the list, fill in the connection details manually.
quickStart.customTypeHint: Model categories are auto-detected by model name in the "Discover Models" step, and can be adjusted per model.
quickStart.needProvider: Please select a provider or fill in the custom connection info
quickStart.keyDesc: This is the API Key you obtained from the provider, used by the gateway to call upstream models. It is never stored or returned in plaintext. Local deployments (e.g. Ollama) can be left empty.
quickStart.keyPlaceholder: Paste the API Key provided by the provider
quickStart.localNoKeyHint: Local services (e.g. Ollama) usually need no key — you can proceed to the next step.
quickStart.needKey: Please enter the upstream API Key (local services can be left empty).
quickStart.importDesc: Click "Discover Models" to fetch available models from upstream. We auto-classify them by type (unsupported types such as video generation are unchecked by default). Select the models you need, then click "Import".
quickStart.defaultTypeTip: Models that cannot be auto-detected fall into this category; manually adjusted categories are kept.
quickStart.unsupportedHint: {count} unsupported models were excluded automatically (e.g. video generation)
quickStart.emptyModels: No available models found. Check the upstream URL and key, or try another provider.
quickStart.needImport: Please import at least one model before continuing.
quickStart.doneDesc: We created a default group and a test key for you. Copy the example below to start calling.
quickStart.creating: Creating default group and test key…
quickStart.keyValueHint: The key is shown only once at creation. Save it securely.
quickStart.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please select the text manually and copy (Ctrl/Cmd+C).
quickStart.providerExistsReuse: Provider already exists — reusing the existing configuration.
quickStart.keyCreateSkipped: Group created, but test key creation failed (possibly no permission): {msg}. Create one manually in API Keys.
quickStart.partialImport: Some models failed to import; {count} imported.
